deities: Lord Shiva as Pashupatinath (lord of beings)

history.summary: The Pashupatinath Temple is a Shiva shrine at Unchehara (also spelled Unchehra), Satna district, about 20-25 km south of Satna city. It is listed on templesofindia.org, but with no data on foundation year, architecture, or festivals - documentation is thin. It is a distinct local shrine and must not be confused with the famous Pashupatinath Temple at Kathmandu, Nepal, or the Ashtamukhi Pashupatinath at Mandsaur, Madhya Pradesh. CSV CORRECTION: the CSV town 'Satna' is approximate - the temple is at Unchehara (postal code 485661), a separate town in Satna district.

name: Pashupatinath Temple
town_description: Unchehara (Unchehra) is a town in Satna district about 20-25 km south of Satna city on the road toward Jabalpur, with its own railway station.
